}}{{TIDTOC|embedded}} ==Overview== *"Model: FDM42L2", "P/N: 08-06FDM4211" and "Ver. V1.1" are silkscreened on the board. *This is a 4-bay NAS. It would appear to have 2x USB 3.0 ports. {{See also|Synology DiskStation Devices|List of NAS Devices}}
===Hardware specification=== *CPU: [[Marvell]] 88F6820 @1.33GHz :Dual-core ''Armada 385'' ([[ARM]] v7) *Memory: 512MB (DDR3L) SDRAM *Storage: 8MB (SPI NOR) Flash, :4x SATA 3.0 ports *Network: 2x Gigabit Ethernet ports *USB: 2x USB 3.0 ports *Power: 12V, 2.5A via barrel
